Instructions for Use
Device description: The Kestrel Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Kestrel Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3 Tesla or less when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Gradient slew rate limited to 200 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- B1+rms must not exceed 1 µT.
- WB-SAR ≤ 1 W/kg.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: MRI mode ON.
Scan regions: Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator.
The image artifact extends approximately 7 mm from the device.
